objective_for_doctor: Evaluate a 67-year-old woman with a change in mental status and abdominal discomfort.

turns.doctor_opening: Hello, what brings you in today? Could you tell me about yourself and what's been going on?
turns.patient_opening: “Hi doctor—lately I’ve become more confused and I can’t seem to get the right words out. I also had a fever around 102°F, and it hurts when you press on my right upper belly area.”

turns.doctor_question: Have you noticed any swelling in your joints?
turns.patient_answer: “No, I haven’t noticed any swelling in my joints. My main issue has been getting more confused, not being able to describe things well, and having a fever with pain in my upper right abdomen when you press there.”

turns.doctor_question: Have you noticed any bumps, sores, or unusual spots on your scalp?
turns.patient_answer: “No, doctor—I haven’t noticed any bumps, sores, or unusual spots on my scalp. My trouble is mainly the sudden increase in confusion and the pain in the upper right part of my abdomen with a fever.”

turns.doctor_question: Have you been experiencing any itching or a persistent urge to scratch anywhere on your body?
turns.patient_answer: “No, I haven’t had itching or a strong urge to scratch—my skin doesn’t feel especially itchy. It’s mainly the new confusion, trouble getting words out, and the fever with pain in my right upper belly area when you press.”

turns.doctor_question: Do you have any trouble lifting your arms above your head?
turns.patient_answer: “No, doctor—I’m still able to lift my arms above my head, though I’ve been more confused lately and it takes me a bit longer to get my words out.”

turns.doctor_question: Have you noticed any loss of vision that isn’t accompanied by pain?
turns.patient_answer: “No, doctor—I haven’t noticed any vision loss, and it hasn’t been associated with pain. My main problems have been getting more confused, struggling to verbalize, and the fever with tenderness in my right upper abdomen.”

turns.doctor_question: Have you had a fever that’s felt extremely hot—like a temperature above 104 °F (40 °C) that’s made you feel dizzy or very uncomfortable?
turns.patient_answer: “No, doctor—I haven’t had a fever above 104°F, and I don’t feel dizzy like that; it’s been around 102°F. I mainly feel more confused than usual, can’t get my words out well, and I have pain in my right upper belly when you press.”

turns.doctor_question: Have you been feeling unusually stressed or overwhelmed lately?
turns.patient_answer: “Not really—my main change has been that I’ve become more confused and can’t verbalize what I’m feeling, and I’ve had that fever and right upper belly tenderness.” “I wouldn’t say I’m more stressed than before; it feels more like my thinking has changed.”

turns.doctor_question: Have you experienced any burning or discomfort when you urinate?
turns.patient_answer: “No, doctor—I haven’t noticed any burning or discomfort when I urinate. My main concerns have been the new confusion and not being able to verbalize well, along with fever around 102°F and tenderness in my right upper belly when you press.”

turns.doctor_question: Have you been feeling chills lately?
turns.patient_answer: “Yes, doctor—I’ve had some chills along with that fever. It started around the same time as the new confusion and the right upper belly tenderness.”

turns.doctor_question: Have you noticed a lump in your breast that feels firm and hasn’t moved?
turns.patient_answer: “No, doctor—I haven’t noticed any firm breast lump or anything unusual there. My main problems have been the new confusion and trouble getting words out, along with fever around 102°F and pain when you press my right upper abdomen.”

turns.doctor_question: Are you feeling any pain or discomfort on the sides of your abdomen, between your ribs and hips?
turns.patient_answer: “No, doctor—the pain is mainly in my right upper abdomen, and I don’t notice much discomfort on the sides between my ribs and hips. My biggest problem is the worsening confusion and that I can’t get the right words out.”
